prompt: Same photograph, same crowd and cabs, same buildings and grey weather. One shows an ice-cold drink can splashing, one a shiny phone on an orange backdrop, one a red sports car, one trainers on electric blue, one a gold perfume bottle, one a burger in close-up. Saturated, punchy, glowing colours spilling onto the wet pavement. Nothing else moves or changes.
